summary: Iteration 17: tested the mobile/tablet touch shell redesign, the invoice send/resend flow and the provider service-area radius. Backend: 6/6 new pytest tests passed (invoice send 403/404/version increment/chat message/customer sees the sent copy; radius validation, 1 km radius hides the provider from a far customer, null restores it). Frontend: for all 6 roles at 390x844, 768x1024 and 820x1180, every sidebar page (about 65 per viewport) showed no horizontal overflow and no text squashed letter by letter; the bottom nav and the Menu left sheet work (navigating closes the sheet). Find Providers Filters pane changes results, the How-it-works pane opens, the My Job Posts right pane opens, Messages shows list then chat with a back button on phone and side by side on tablet. Breakpoint is exact: 1023 = touch shell, 1024 = desktop. Desktop at 1920 is unchanged (filters inline, inline job detail panel, two-column messages), and the phone-frame preview with iframe and Back to desktop works. Invoice: provider resend v2->v3 with toast 'email could not be delivered' and badge 'in chat only'; customer sees 'Sent by your provider ... (updated, v3)' with no send button, plus the chat message. Service area card: toggle, slider, save and persist after reload all work. Demo provider radius reset to null at the end. One UI bug: on Track Workers the 'Workers' floating button is hidden behind the Leaflet map on phone and tablet.

minor.issue: service_radius_km=true is accepted (bool is a subclass of int in Python) and stored as true, so it acts as a 1 km radius. Add `isinstance(r, bool)` to the rejection check.
Validation allows up to 500 km but the UI slider max is 200. A radius of 201-500 set through the API shows a slider value off the scale. Align the limits or clamp the slider.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Workers' button (workers-pane-trigger, fixed, z-30) is drawn under the Leaflet map panes (z-index 400+) and cannot be seen at 390 or 820, so users cannot discover the team pane. It can still be clicked because Leaflet tiles have pointer-events:none. Fix: add isolation/z-0 to the map wrapper div (`flex-1 relative min-w-0` -> add `z-0` or `isolate`) or raise the button's z-index (e.g. z-[1000]).

issues: The notification bell (mobile-notifications-btn) has no onClick handler; it is decorative only (also true before this change).
The 'Search conversations' input does nothing and has no data-testid.

action_items: Fix the TrackWorkers 'Workers' button being hidden behind the Leaflet map on phone/tablet (stacking context / z-index)
Reject boolean service_radius_km in PATCH /api/providers/me; align the 500 km backend limit with the 200 km slider
Optional: give the notifications bell a handler and make the messages search work
critical_code_review_comments: SidePane.jsx: fixed position buttons use z-30 and will sit under any Leaflet/map content. Consider a higher z-index for side-pane-fab globally.

ViewModeContext: detectDefault stores 'mobile' for phones (<768) in localStorage; if the same browser later opens at desktop width it will land in the framed phone preview. This is probably fine, but be aware of it.
send_job_invoice: the email goes only to client_id; the job's approver_id (property manager etc.) gets neither the chat message nor the email. Confirm this is intended.
PATCH /providers/me upserts provider_profiles for any role (a customer calling it would create a profile). This predates this change, but a role check is advisable.

success_rate.frontend: ~96% (1 visual bug: Workers button hidden on Track Workers)

seed_data_creation: No new records. Invoice for job_3f75aa7134 resent twice (now v3) and the demo customer's thread got 2 extra 'updated invoice' chat messages. Demo provider service_radius_km was set temporarily (1 km, 30 km) and reset to null (verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use demo-login cookie auth through page.request.post('/api/auth/demo-login', {role}). Clear localStorage 'dispatchr_view_mode' before desktop tests. Quote attribute selectors that contain dots, e.g. [data-testid="filter-min_rating-4.5"]. Leaflet tiles have pointer-events:none, so elementFromPoint/visibility checks can falsely pass; verify map-overlay buttons with screenshots. Always reset the demo provider service_radius_km to null.
